text: This staff report concerns a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. The purpose of this report is to advise Council concerning an application by the property owner of 24 Cedar Ave for a site-specific Fence Exemption, pursuant to Section 447-5.C of Toronto Municipal Code, Chapter 447- Fences. The property owner is seeking Council's permission to , which does not comply with stipulated by Section of the bylaw. The fence is installed along the west side lot line (abutting 22 Cedar Ave) and along the rear private laneway. The fence on the west side ranges from 2.3 m to 2.6 m (7 feet 7 inches to 8 feet 7 inches) in height and approximately 15 m (50 feet) wide.
